_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil respects the 5% base rate of meaningful moves — HOLD is the statistically honest default until ETF flows spike above 40 or VIX breaks above 80 to force a directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls Disbelief next with medium conviction; narrative implies upside reversal potential but does not name a forward phase, creating an implicit directional split (analyst neutral-up, narrative bullish-up).
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows spike above 40 and stablecoin_growth recovers above 45 with btc_momentum_30d holding above 45
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows remain below 15 and vix breaks above 80 with btc_momentum_30d falling below 35, pushing score toward Anxiety
